claims.text: Our workshop is open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 6:00pm, and on Saturday from 8:30am to 1:00pm.
claims.subject: Opening hours

claims.text: We are closed on Sundays and on Singapore public holidays.
claims.subject: Opening hours
claims.object: We are closed on Sundays and on Singapore public holidays.

claims.text: The last appointment slot on weekdays starts at 4:00pm, so that our technicians have time to finish the job and road-test your car before closing.
claims.subject: Opening hours

claims.text: On Saturdays the last appointment slot starts at 12:00pm.
claims.subject: Opening hours

claims.text: Our service desk answers phone calls during opening hours only.
claims.subject: Opening hours
claims.object: Our service desk answers phone calls during opening hours only.

claims.text: Outside opening hours you can leave a message through this chat and a service advisor will reply on the next working day.
claims.subject: Opening hours
claims.object: Outside opening hours you can leave a message through this chat and a service advisor will reply on the next working day.

claims.text: Car collection: if your car is ready after we close, it stays safely inside the workshop overnight and you can collect it from 8:30am the next working day.
claims.subject: Opening hours

claims.text: There is no storage charge for the first two days.
claims.subject: Opening hours
claims.object: There is no storage charge for the first two days.

claims.text: We are at Block 88 Kallang Way 5, #01-23, Singapore 349988.
